meta.name: Steno.ai
limitations: The site's hero covered the first capture with a full-height intro animation; the entry page was re-captured once it finished, and clips were taken from that same load. If the intro replays, the source screenshot will be showing it.
PP Writer and PP Mori are licensed display faces, not shipped here; specimens fall back to Georgia and Arial.

The hero's right frame is a render (653×512 video still with a 1px inset). Only its size, inset, radius and motion were measured; the artwork itself is shown as the captured frame in Fidelity, never copied.
`#CAFF75` and `#2D62FF` are declared variables; only the lime is used on the home page (inside one icon).
The CTA's hover was measured with a real pointer; the computed delta stayed inside the frame's entry wobble, so brick.md reports the measured numbers and does not invent bigger ones.
No prefers-reduced-motion block exists on any of the four pages; reduce is therefore a measured absence, not a branch to copy.
openQuestions: Is the hero frame a video on every viewport, or a static still on mobile?
Do the /about and /team sections reuse the same dark section palette?

patterns.name: Cinematic sheet, streaming landscape
patterns.rule: The hero is one full-width landscape frame (653×512 video still, inset 1px) with a piece of copy pinned to its left; product cards become hashed collage slices (rotate(−6°/+4°)) rather than floating UI.
patterns.goal: Reads as an editorial spread for the brand, not a dashboard of features.

patterns.name: Oatmeal-only palette
patterns.rule: Both light and dark are the same hue: #F0EDDA / #282724, with #FFFDF1, #CFCCB1, #DAD7C1 as bands and #BAA57B as the one product surface; #CAFF75 is the sole chromatic accent (spot).
patterns.goal: Keeps photography (amber grass, teal dusk) as the only wide colour field, and ties every panel back to paper.

patterns.name: Paper-serif hero, sans everywhere else
patterns.rule: DISPLAY text is PP Writer 400 (no weight heavier than 400); interface and labels are PP Mori 400, with 600 only for the label inside filled CTA buttons.
patterns.goal: A serif statement asks for reading, not scanning; sans keeps the product-state lines compact.

patterns.name: 8px softness everywhere except the quote pill
patterns.rule: Controls, cards and the hero frame share radius 8px; pills and option cards use 1600px to their role; shadow is an edge, not a depth cue.
patterns.goal: One precision so a reader never wonders which layer they are looking at.

patterns.name: Neon is a spot, never a surface
patterns.rule: #CAFF75 appears only inside the hero eyebrow glyph (a disk behind a triangular play mark); no background, border or text of this hue is allowed.
patterns.goal: A single mark turns the eyebrow into a video cue without competing with the hero imagery.

taste.name: The button slip is the whole interaction
taste.trigger: Deciding how a filled CTA reacts to the pointer on a page whose hero is a moving image.
taste.decision: On hover the button's inner fill resets its transform (translate 0 / rotate 0) over 525ms with cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1); the label does not move.
taste.chose: one accent-brown slip inside the 8px frame
taste.over: lift/shadow and scale on the whole button, or a second accent colour on the fill
taste.reason: A page already carrying an image is already loud (the restrained motion is a slip, not a raise); the icon fill turning a shade lighter tells the pointer 'active' without a second focal point.

guardrail.note: The control's only motion is the measured 525ms transform slip; a hover shadow is a violation.

taste.name: Photo is the only colour cut
taste.trigger: Deciding where the accent may appear on a hero that carries a full-size photograph.
taste.decision: #CAFF75 stays a spot (one per page at most, inside an icon), #2D62FF link slot never touches a filled control; cards use #BAA57B on the ink canvas.
taste.chose: neon spot inside an icon + brand card on ink
taste.over: neon-filled CTA, or #2D62FF primary buttons on every section
taste.reason: Amber grass and teal dusk raise the luminance of every near region of the hero; a chromatic fill at button scale would flatten the lightness contrast the serif headline relies on.

taste.name: Grain and grain only are allowed to move
taste.trigger: Deciding what animates when the page opens and when a pointer reaches a control.
taste.decision: Transitions on transform with a single curve (0.525s cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1)); text reveal, hand-cut clipping and image renders run in layers over that.
taste.chose: one transform curve with 0.3s opacity support
taste.over: spring/bounce easings and staggered keyframes per element
taste.reason: The hero's frame and copy float in one timeline, so extra easing on any child just adds a second rhythm; one curve keeps copy and card reading as one.

taste.name: Grain without motion drift
taste.trigger: Running under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (zero blocks on any of the four pages).
taste.decision: Under reduce lewitt plays every motion at its end state instantly (opacity/transform to done), and the brick states the reduce branch it measured.
taste.chose: the same timeline with 0.3s opacity support
taste.reason: The page reads as a document; a drifting parallax under a document is a visual defect, not an effect to slow down, so a build that mirrors this site must add the branch the site is missing.
